address: Atlantis The Royal, Crescent Road, The Palm, Dubai
bio: It’s not just the wonderful bounty from the sea displayed on ice that’s the attraction at this smart and impeccably run restaurant in the grounds of Atlantis The Royal; the Hellenic menu offers up plenty of other choices, like a terrific tomato and aged feta salad, along with some special Greek wines. At lunch there’s a great value Business Lunch menu....
